name: Sujith Bandaru
firstLine: I’ve never liked the phrase ‘not in the same boat’. Why can’t I just invite you onto mine?
description: My home on the internet: where I have been, what I am building and what I am thinking about.
pinnedSentence: Chosen or not, I made the most of it.
floorLine: You made it all the way down. Here’s how to reach me.
workIntro: Passion projects, with nothing to prove.
workMore: Just the one so far. This website is only the start.
writingIntro: What I’m thinking about, as I go.
journeyEnd: That is as far down as it goes, for now
lostLine: This page has drifted off, or never existed. The boat is still where you left it.
